info.title: snap: review and accept Nullean.Snapshots snapshots
info.description: List, diff, accept and reject pending snapshots from Nullean.Snapshots, and run browser journeys and .http files.

commands.name: accept
commands.description:
Accept received snapshots: write them as verified and delete the
received files. An inline snapshot is written into the string literal
of its test instead, which edits the test's .cs file.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --all
options.description: Accept every pending snapshot.

options.name: --root
options.description: The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]

arguments.name: KEYS
arguments.description: [variadic] Keys from 'snap status', unique suffixes of them, or globs.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show how a received snapshot differs from its verified file.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --root
options.description: The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: A key from 'snap status', any unique suffix of one, or a glob.

commands.name: orphans
commands.description:
List verified snapshots the latest test run did not use. Exits 1 when
there are any.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print a JSON array of {project, verified} instead.

options.name: --delete
options.description: Delete them. Run the whole test suite first: a filtered run skips snapshots.

options.name: --root
options.description: The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]

commands.name: reject
commands.description:
Reject received snapshots: delete the received files and keep the
verified ones.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --all
options.description: Reject every pending snapshot.

options.name: --root
options.description: The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]

arguments.name: KEYS
arguments.description: [variadic] Keys from 'snap status', unique suffixes of them, or globs.

commands.name: review
commands.description:
Review pending snapshots one by one: see each diff, then accept,
reject or skip it.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --root
options.description: The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]

commands.name: status
commands.description: List pending snapshots. Exits 1 when there are any.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print a JSON array of {key, ext, state, verified, received} instead.

options.name: --root
options.description: The folder to search from. Defaults to the current folder. [default: null]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version.
Namespaces:
http     Run .http files and compare their responses with the verified
snapshots.
journey  Run browser journeys and compare their transcripts with the verified
